breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent failed to fix this and repeated both contradictory conditions in its output, stating both 'Dirichlet at x=0 and x=1: u = 0' and 'Periodic spatial boundaries'.
